description:
Outcome: Owner sees allocation working end to end, from brief.md / First version 1–3 and Rules; owner map deferral.
Scope: Local working application, allocation, waitlist and own-status demonstration with fictional records. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Criteria: demonstrate returning priority, household uniqueness, global FIFO and season dates including deadline boundary cases; record owner feedback.
Behaviour: Unmet criteria stay open; unrelated reporting work can proceed. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Recorded owner walkthrough of local app; no staging prerequisite. Prerequisites: T-007, T-008. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover. Stage-1 limitation: checkpoint is an ordinary ticket and approval is not mechanically enforced.
title: Checkpoint: allocation milestone
